title: Zeroizing<Vec<u8>> for CEK and KEK — worth defending
description: encrypt_aes_cbc returns the CEK as Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>; ecdh_wrap_cek holds the KEK as Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>; find_and_decrypt_cek returns Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>. This ensures key material is scrubbed from heap memory when the Vec is dropped. A contributor cleaning up 'unnecessary' type wrappers would introduce a key-material leak. The Zeroize dependency is already listed and its use here is the entire justification for it.
close_reason: Zeroizing rationale in encrypt.rs:197 and decrypt.rs:96 doc comments; scrub-on-drop behavior is the point of the dep
